decisions.reason: Designating a new working file does not change the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the title.
The authoritative file designation is already owned by the source requirement and does not change the approved copyediting goals or passages.
The source does not alter any image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirement.
The working-file designation does not resolve or change the cover design preference or its existing ambiguity.
The source does not add, remove, or modify the required back matter or author lines.
Selecting a working file does not resume or modify the deferred paragraph-spacing requirement.
The requirement to italicize the Mama's Hot Take text remains valid unchanged.
The working-file decision does not change the permitted image source, review obligation, or suitability criteria.
The source does not change chapter image coverage, placement, presentation, or image references.
The manuscript working-file designation does not alter the guided KDP workflow or assistance terms.
The source does not modify the required subtitle treatment for Chapter 18.
The working-file designation does not change the table-of-contents update requirement or its timing.
